name: Morisumi Ichika
source:
- A girl who has perfect wife's skills and is easy to get along with, but also a slight tendency to delusions.

Ichika is the same age as the protagonist, is the most reliable person in the dorm and has common sense. She's good at living on her own and great at cooking. A girl who would firmly support her future husband.
In the dorm she's always in charge of tsukkomi. Also, she tends to lose herself in delusions and blush all alone in the corner of her room.
Although she's a mediator in the dorm, Ichika is weak when pressured by others and ends up being dragged down by others' pace.

*Charm Point: Will spoil you
*Gap Moe: She's a closet pervert

Study Course: Cooking - Boulanger​ (bread-baking)

[Based on translation from [url=http://www.hook-net.jp/smee/sugarstyle/main/character/chara1.html]developer's site[/url]]
